reviews.title: Samsung used to be dependable.  I just had a 3 year old QN800C 8K tv become a brick 1 week ago!
reviews.text:
My Samsung QN800C 8K that I purchased directly from Samsung in July, 2023 died last week.  

I was told by a local tv technician that every Samsung tv that uses the One Connect as a power source to the flatscreen will cause it to die due to overheating. 

This occurred due to inherent design flaws introduced to that generation of Samsung NQED’s.  

They eventually redesigned and replaced the One Connect to be wireless and reconfigured the flatscreen to have its own dedicated power source which minimizes the overheating problem.

I have owned multiple previous generations of Samsung 4K tv’s from the initial 1st generation about 10-12 years ago thru subsequent generations.

My old Samsung LED 4K is still working after sitting in my great room since 2014!

My 2nd generation Samsung QLED 4K is still working in my bedroom since 2018.

The Samsung QN800C 8K was sitting in my Library/Theater room only since July,2023!!!

I have had to purchase a replacement from a third party supplier for the redesigned Samsung 8K QN990F.

I can see that it does have 2 power sources for both the flatscreen and the wireless One Connect.

Hopefully it will work!!!

I paid over $3600 plus white glove installation fee for a tv tgst died in 3 years and 4 months!!

If it dies too quickly as this previous one did, I will never buy a Samsung tv again!!!!

Es ist absolut unverständlich, dass ein so wichtiger Dienst plötzlich nicht mehr verfügbar ist und man dadurch möglicherweise die Kontrolle über wichtige Funktionen im eigenen Smart Home verliert. Ein Samsung-Konto ist für viele Nutzer nicht einfach irgendein Konto, sondern die Grundlage für die tägliche Nutzung vernetzter Geräte.

Besonders ärgerlich ist, dass man auf eine schnelle und unkomplizierte Wiederherstellung angewiesen ist, aber als Nutzer mit diesem Problem allein dasteht. Von einem Unternehmen wie Samsung erwarte ich einen zuverlässigen Service, transparente Kommunikation und vor allem eine schnelle Lösung bei Kontoproblemen.

Samsung muss hier dringend nachbessern! Ich erwarte, dass mein Konto schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird und ich meine Hausautomatisierung wie gewohnt nutzen kann. So etwas darf bei einem derart wichtigen Dienst einfach nicht passieren.

reviews.text:
Honestly, not good enough for the money we paid.

The navigation is extremely unreliable. You constantly have to look for the robot because it gets stuck, and sometimes it will clean half of the flat and then tell you it couldn’t find a particular room. The rooms haven’t moved since yesterday! 😂 On other occasions, for some reason, it decides to clean just one room, so you simply cannot trust it to do what you have scheduled.

The LiDAR sensor is another constant issue. It regularly says that the sensor is obstructed and needs cleaning, even when I have literally cleaned it five minutes earlier. I actually had the robot sent away for repairs during the first year. It seemed to improve slightly afterwards, but the problems have never completely gone away.

And despite all the advertising about the brush reaching into corners, it simply doesn’t do a good job of cleaning them. It regularly leaves dust and bits of rubbish sitting in the corners.

You also have to move things out of its way before running it because even a chair or another object in the wrong place seems to confuse the navigation. At that point, I honestly find it quicker to just grab the Hoover and clean the flat myself than spend time checking where the robot has got stuck and whether it has actually cleaned everything.

reviews.text: This app is getting two stars because for a Washer And Dryer it’s pretty much pointless. You can send settings that you want set on the machine and send the setting to your machine, but you literally have to go to the machine to start it, stop it, restart it. So, although you will get a notification that your dryer load is done, for example, if you want to restart it or keep your clothes, wrinkle free and you’re nowhere near the machine then you can’t do that. For myself, I can only think of one reason it would be useful to send Settings to my Washer And Dryer, and that would be in the event. My kids want to watch something and don’t know what setting to use, I can send the setting to the machine from my phone, but they will still have to physically go to the machine to start and stop it. I spent thousands on my set, and despite the price tag, my dryer rarely dries on the first round, no matter how hot of a setting I put it on. So, I know I will always have to run my dryer twice at a minimum. It would be nice to be able to just restart my dryer from my phone. reviews.title: Disappointing decision to put the SmartThings API behind a paywall
reviews.text:
I already own a Samsung Family Hub refrigerator and two Samsung TVs, and until now I was planning to buy a Samsung dishwasher, washing machine and dryer as well.

Unfortunately, this decision has completely changed my mind.

In my opinion, putting the SmartThings API behind a subscription feels like corporate greed. Customers already spend thousands on Samsung hardware, yet we’re now expected to pay a monthly fee just to integrate devices we already own with our own smart home.

I would happily pay for new premium features or cloud services, but charging for API access to my own devices is not something I can support.

Instead of making Samsung products more open and embracing platforms like Home Assistant, this decision pushes loyal customers to look at competing brands.

I sincerely hope Samsung reconsiders this decision or at least offers a free tier for personal, non-commercial use.
